summary: Your first Sunday review. You answer 8 questions from the whole week with a confidence number, turn your confusions into 3 themes, catch up on what is not ticked, tag your first week in Git, and plan week 2 with one outcome and a drop list.
goal: Say what you know and what you do not from week 1, and choose one fix and one goal for week 2.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 8 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Error log: group this week's confusions into 3 themes and fix the top one with a 5-minute experiment
Catch up: tick every unfinished step of Day 0 to Day 7, in order
Run git tag week-1 and see tag: week-1 in git log --oneline --decorate
Plan week 2: write one outcome sentence, put 7 sessions in your calendar, and write your drop list
Play the Week 1 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
